http-request-streaming.node/3va: 3va buffers an incrementally-written request body and sends Content-Length; node sends Transfer-Encoding: chunked. Status and body bytes are identical, only the framing header differs. Listed as a 2.13.0 target (streaming/flushHeaders semantics). Remove this entry when 3va frames incremental writes as chunked.
http-request-streaming.3va/3va: same as node/3va: the 3va client buffers the incrementally-written body and frames it with Content-Length instead of chunked.

tls-private-ca.node/3va: the 3va `https`/`tls` client does not read NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS: the non-FIPS path uses native-tls (OpenSSL), which trusts only the OS store, so a private CA trusted via that variable fails to verify (`unable to get local issuer certificate`). fetch() does honour it (rustls/ureq path). Listed as a 2.13.0 target. Remove this entry when the OpenSSL TLS client honours NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS.
tls-private-ca.3va/3va: same as node/3va: the 3va client cannot verify the private CA that the 3va server presents via NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS.

esm-mjs-import.3va: a relative import whose target ends in .mjs fails with `require() of ES module ... not supported. Use import() instead.`; .js targets resolve as ESM. The CLI dispatches the .mjs dependency through the CJS loader. Listed as a 2.13.0 target. Remove this entry when importing a relative .mjs works.

esm-cyclic-import.3va: in an import cycle the binding read from the other module stays undefined instead of the live binding node exposes: main prints cycle-a's aValue correctly (`a->b`) but cycle-b's seenA() returns `undefined` instead of `a->b`. Listed as a 2.13.0 target. Remove this entry when cycles expose live bindings.
